en.s: The Battle of the Yarmuk (also spelled Yarmouk; Arabic: معركة اليرموك) was a major battle between the Byzantine Empire and the Rashidun Caliphate near the Yarmouk River in Byzantine Syria that marked a crucial point in the Muslim conquest of Syria. The result of the battle was a decisive Arab victory that effectively ended Byzantine rule in Syria.

zh.s: 雅穆克河战役（也写作Yarmouk；阿拉伯语：معركة اليرموك）是拜占庭帝国与拉希顿哈里发国在拜占庭叙利亚、雅穆克河附近进行的一场重要战役，是穆斯林征服叙利亚的关键节点。阿拉伯军队取得决定性胜利，拜占庭对叙利亚的统治实际上就此结束。

en.s: In 717–718, Constantinople, the capital of the Byzantine Empire, was besieged by the Muslim Arabs of the Umayyad Caliphate. The campaign marked the culmination of twenty years of attacks and progressive Arab occupation of the Byzantine borderlands, while Byzantine strength was sapped by prolonged internal turmoil. In 716, after years of preparations, the Arabs, led by Maslama ibn Abd al-Malik, invaded Byzantine Asia Minor. The Arabs initially hoped to exploit Byzantine civil strife and made common cause with the general Leo III the Isaurian, who had risen up against Emperor Theodosius III. Leo, however, deceived them and secured the Byzantine throne for himself. After wintering in the western coastlands of Asia Minor, the Arab army crossed into Thrace in the early summer of 717 and built siege lines to blockade the city, which was protected by the massive Theodosian Walls. The Arab fleet, which accompanied the land army and was meant to complete the city's blockade by sea, was partly neutralized soon after its arrival by the Byzantine navy through the use of Greek fire. This allowed Constantinople to be resupplied by sea, while the Arab army was crippled by famine and disease during the unusually hard winter that followed. In spring 718, two Arab fleets sent as reinforcements were destroyed by the Byzantines after their Christian crews defected, and an additional army sent overland through Asia Minor was ambushed and defeated. Coupled with attacks by the Bulgars on their rear, the Arabs were forced to lift the siege on 15 August 718.

zh.s: 717至718年，倭马亚哈里发国的穆斯林阿拉伯军队围攻拜占庭帝国首都君士坦丁堡。这场战役是阿拉伯人持续20年进攻并逐步占领拜占庭边境地区的高潮；拜占庭的实力此前因长期内乱而削弱。716年，阿拉伯人在多年准备后，由马斯拉马·伊本·阿卜杜勒-马利克率领入侵拜占庭小亚细亚。阿拉伯人起初希望利用拜占庭内乱，遂与反抗皇帝狄奥多西三世的将军利奥三世结盟。但利奥骗过他们，自己夺取了拜占庭皇位。阿拉伯军队在小亚细亚西岸过冬后，于717年初夏渡过赫勒斯滂海峡进入色雷斯，并构筑围城工事封锁城市。君士坦丁堡由宏大的狄奥多西城墙保护。阿拉伯舰队随陆军抵达，原计划从海上完成封锁，但拜占庭海军很快使用希腊火削弱了这支舰队。于是君士坦丁堡得以从海上补给，而阿拉伯军队在之后异常严酷的冬季遭受饥荒和疾病打击。718年春，两支阿拉伯援军舰队在基督徒船员叛逃后被拜占庭人摧毁；另一支经小亚细亚陆路派来的军队也遭伏击并被击败。保加利亚人同时从阿拉伯军队后方进攻，阿拉伯人最终于718年8月15日被迫解除围城。

en.s: The Battle of Roncevaux Pass (French and English spelling, Roncesvalles in Spanish, Orreaga in Basque) in 778 saw a large force of Basques ambush a part of Charlemagne's army in Roncevaux Pass, a high mountain pass in the Pyrenees on the present border between France and Spain, after his invasion of the Iberian Peninsula. The Basque attack was in retaliation for Charlemagne's destruction of the city walls of their capital, Pamplona.

zh.t: 龙塞斯瓦列斯山口战役
zh.s: 778年，巴斯克人大举伏击了查理曼军队的一部分。战斗发生在龙塞斯瓦列斯山口（法语和英语拼法为Roncevaux，西班牙语为Roncesvalles，巴斯克语为Orreaga），这里是比利牛斯山脉中连接现今法国与西班牙的高山隘口。巴斯克人的袭击是为了报复查理曼摧毁其首都潘普洛纳的城墙；此前查理曼刚入侵伊比利亚半岛。

en.s: The Battle of Tawahin took place on 15 August 978 between the Fatimid army, led in person by Caliph al-Aziz, and the forces of Alptakin, the Turkic ruler of Damascus. The battle followed a series of back-and-forth operations by both sides for control of Palestine and southern Syria during the previous years, in which Fatimid forces had advanced from Egypt, only to be defeated and thrown back by varying combinations of regional rivals.

zh.s: 塔瓦欣战役于978年8月15日爆发，交战双方是由哈里发阿齐兹亲自率领的法蒂玛军队，以及突厥统治者、时任大马士革统治者阿尔普塔金的军队。此前几年，双方为争夺巴勒斯坦和叙利亚南部展开多轮攻防。法蒂玛军队曾从埃及北进，后来被不同地区势力组成的联军击败并击退。

en.s: The Battle of Lumphanan was fought on 15 August 1057, between Macbeth, King of Scotland, and Máel Coluim mac Donnchada, the future King Malcolm III. Macbeth was killed, having drawn his retreating forces north to make a last stand. According to tradition, the battle took place near the Peel of Lumphanan in Aberdeenshire. Macbeth's Stone, some 300 metres (980 ft) south-west of the peel, is said to be the stone upon which Macbeth was beheaded.

zh.s: 卢姆法南战役于1057年8月15日爆发，交战双方是苏格兰国王麦克白与未来的国王马尔科姆三世（马埃尔·科鲁伊姆·马克·唐查达）。麦克白率领残部向北撤退，准备最后一战，最终阵亡。据传，战斗发生在阿伯丁郡卢姆法南城堡附近。距城堡西南约300米处的麦克白之石，据说就是麦克白被斩首之处。

en.s: The First Crusade (1096–1099) was the first of a series of religious wars, or Crusades, which were initiated, supported and at times directed by the Latin Church in the Middle Ages. Their aim was to return the Holy Land to Christian rule after its conquest by the Rashidun Caliphate in the 7th century.

zh.t: 教宗乌尔班二世所定第一次十字军东征开始日期
zh.s: 第一次十字军东征（1096—1099年）是中世纪拉丁教会发起、支持并有时指挥的一系列宗教战争（即十字军东征）中的第一次。其目标是在公元7世纪拉希顿哈里发国征服圣地后，将圣地重新置于基督教统治之下。

en.s: The Battle of Consuegra was a battle of the Spanish Reconquista fought on August 15, 1097 near the village of Consuegra in the province of Castile-La Mancha between the Castilian and Leonese army of Alfonso VI and the Almoravids under Yusuf ibn Tashfin. The battle soon turned into Almoravid victory and the son of El Cid, Diego Rodríguez, perished. Alfonso with some Leónese retreated into the castle of Consuegra, which was besieged for eight days until the Almoravids withdraw to the south.

zh.s: 孔苏埃格拉战役于1097年8月15日在西班牙收复失地运动期间爆发，地点在卡斯蒂利亚-拉曼恰省孔苏埃格拉村附近。交战双方是阿方索六世率领的卡斯蒂利亚和莱昂联军，以及优素福·伊本·塔什芬率领的穆拉比特王朝军队。穆拉比特军很快获胜，熙德之子迭戈·罗德里格斯阵亡。阿方索与部分莱昂军退入孔苏埃格拉城堡，被围困八天，直到穆拉比特军向南撤退。

en.s: The Siege of Carcassonne was a military engagement which took place from August 1, 1209, to August 15, 1209, during the Albigensian Crusade. It took place in the Languedoc region of southern France at the fortified town of Carcassonne. The Siege was led by Arnaud Amaury as part of the Crusader effort to eliminate Catharism, a Christian sect regarded as heretical, from Southern France.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 卡尔卡松围城战于1209年8月1日至15日发生在法国南部朗格多克地区坚固设防的卡尔卡松镇，是阿尔比十字军东征期间的一场军事行动。围城由阿尔诺·阿马尔里克率领，属于十字军清除法国南部异端基督教派卡特里派的行动之一。

en.s: The siege of Tartu, or Dorpat, took place in 1224 and resulted in the fall of the last major center of Estonian resistance in the mainland provinces to the Christian conquest of Estonia.

zh.s: 1224年，塔尔图（又称多尔帕特）遭到围攻。围城导致爱沙尼亚大陆地区最后一个主要抵抗据点陷落，结束了当地对基督教征服的抵抗。

en.s: The Battle of the Puig of 1237, also known as the Battle of the Puig de Santa Maria, the Battle of the Puig de Enesa, or the Battle of the Puig de Cepolla was a battle of the Iberian Reconquista and of the Aragonese Conquest of Valencia.

zh.s: 1237年的普伊格战役又称圣玛利亚普伊格战役、埃内萨普伊格战役或塞波拉普伊格战役，是伊比利亚收复失地运动和阿拉贡征服瓦伦西亚期间的一场战斗。

en.s: The First Battle of Athenry was fought on 15 August 1249 at Athenry (Irish: Áth na Ríogh) in modern County Galway, Ireland. The Irish forces of Connacht besieged the town but were repelled by the English under Jordan de Exeter, Sheriff of Connacht. Áth na Ríogh had existed as a Gaelic settlement under the Ó Mainnín kings of Soghain [1], but between 1236 and 1241 Meyler de Bermingham captured the area and made Athenry an urban walled settlement.

zh.s: 第一次阿森里战役于1249年8月15日在阿森里（爱尔兰语：Áth na Ríogh）爆发，地点在今天爱尔兰戈尔韦郡。康诺特的爱尔兰军队围攻该镇，但被康诺特郡长乔丹·德·埃克塞特率领的英格兰人击退。阿森里原是索盖恩地区奥·梅宁国王统治下的盖尔人聚居地；1236年至1241年间，迈勒·德·伯明翰攻占该地区，并将阿森里建成有城墙的城市聚落。

en.t: Michael VIII Palaiologos was crowned Byzantine emperor in Constantinople
en.s: Michael VIII Palaiologos or Palaeologus (Greek: Μιχαὴλ Δούκας Ἄνγελος Κομνηνὸς Παλαιολόγος, romanized: Mikhaḗl Doúkās Ángelos Komnēnós Palaiológos; 1224 – 11 December 1282) reigned as Byzantine emperor from 1261 until his death in 1282, and previously as the co-emperor of the Empire of Nicaea from 1259 to 1261. Michael VIII was the founder of the Palaiologan dynasty that would rule the Byzantine Empire until the Fall of Constantinople in 1453.

zh.t: 米海尔八世·巴列奥略在君士坦丁堡加冕为拜占庭皇帝
zh.s: 米海尔八世·巴列奥略，全名米海尔·杜卡斯·安格洛斯·科穆宁·巴列奥略，生于1224年，卒于1282年12月11日。他于1261年至1282年去世前担任拜占庭皇帝，此前在1259年至1261年担任尼西亚帝国共治皇帝。他建立的巴列奥略王朝统治拜占庭帝国，直至1453年君士坦丁堡陷落。

en.s: The Knights Hospitaller, led by Grand Master Foulques de Villaret, landed on Rhodes in summer 1306 and quickly conquered most of it except for the city of Rhodes, which remained in Byzantine hands. Emperor Andronikos II Palaiologos sent reinforcements, which allowed the city to repel the initial Hospitaller attacks, and persevere until it was captured on 15 August 1310.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 医院骑士团征服罗得岛
zh.s: 医院骑士团在大团长富尔克·德·维拉雷率领下，于1306年夏登陆罗得岛，并很快征服了岛上大部分地区，只有仍由拜占庭控制的罗得城例外。皇帝安德洛尼卡二世·巴列奥略派遣援军，使该城击退医院骑士团最初的进攻，并坚持到1310年8月15日被攻占。

en.s: The Battle of Lough Raska (Irish: Loch Rasca) or Battle of Corcomroe (Irish: Corca Mrua) took place on 15 August 1317 near Corcomroe Abbey in north County Clare, Ireland. It was part of a fight for control of the Uí Briain chieftaincy and part of the Anglo-Norman wars in Ireland. Forces loyal to Muircheartach Ó Briain were commanded by Diarmait Ó Briain in a pitched battle against Donnchadh Ó Briain, who was an ally of Mathghamhain Ó Briain and Richard de Clare. Both armies were about 9,000 men each. Diarmait Ó Briain's forces were victorious.

zh.s: 洛夫拉斯卡湖战役（爱尔兰语：Loch Rasca），又称科克姆罗战役（爱尔兰语：Corca Mrua），于1317年8月15日在爱尔兰克莱尔郡北部的科克姆罗修道院附近爆发。这场战斗是争夺乌伊·布里安首领之位的冲突之一，也属于爱尔兰的盎格鲁-诺曼战争。效忠缪尔赫塔赫·奥·布里安的军队由迪尔穆德·奥·布里安率领，与邓肯·奥·布里安的军队交战；邓肯一方与马格哈曼·奥·布里安和理查德·德·克莱尔结盟。双方各约有9000人，迪尔穆德一方获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Ghedi was a battle during the long conflict between the Republic of Venice and the Duchy of Milan which lasted between the years 1425 and 1454 (the year in which the Peace of Lodi was signed). This battle took place on 15 August 1453 near the Lombard town of Ghedi. The clash allowed the Duchy of Milan to recover a big part of Bassa Bresciana.

zh.s: 盖迪战役是威尼斯共和国与米兰公国长期冲突中的一场战斗，这场冲突持续于1425年至1454年（《洛迪和约》签署之年）。战斗于1453年8月15日在伦巴第的盖迪镇附近爆发，使米兰公国得以收复布雷西亚下地的一大片地区。

en.s: The Battle of Mombasa in 1505 was a military engagement between Portuguese forces under the command of the first Viceroy of India Dom Francisco de Almeida and the Sultanate of Mombasa. The Portuguese staged a landing and sacked the city on the occasion.

zh.s: 1505年，葡萄牙军队与蒙巴萨苏丹国交战，葡军由首任印度总督弗朗西斯科·德·阿尔梅达指挥。葡萄牙人实施登陆，并在此过程中洗劫了该城。

en.s: Panama City, also known as Panama, is the capital and largest city of the Republic of Panama. It has a total population of 410,354 in the city proper and 1,086,990 in the Panamá District, which includes the outer corregimientos of the city. The metropolitan area has over 2,100,000 people. The city is at the Pacific entrance of the Panama Canal, in the province of Panama.

zh.t: 巴拿马的巴拿马城建城
zh.s: 巴拿马城也称巴拿马，是巴拿马共和国的首都和最大城市。市区人口共410,354人；包括城市外围区在内的巴拿马区人口为1,086,990人。大都市区人口超过2,100,000人。该市位于巴拿马省，坐落在巴拿马运河的太平洋入口处。

en.s: Asunción (English: , Spanish: [asunˈsjon] ; Guarani: Paraguay) is the capital and the largest city of Paraguay. The city lies on the eastern bank of the Paraguay River, immediately north northeast of the confluence where it is joined by the Pilcomayo River. The Paraguay River separates Asunción from the Occidental Region of Paraguay to the northwest, and from Argentina to the southwest.

zh.s: 亚松森（西班牙语： [asunˈsjon]；瓜拉尼语：Paraguay）是巴拉圭的首都和最大城市。该市位于巴拉圭河东岸，紧邻巴拉圭河与皮尔科马约河交汇处的东北偏北方向。巴拉圭河将亚松森与西北方的巴拉圭西部地区以及西南方的阿根廷隔开。

en.s: Arequipa is a city in southern Peru and the capital of Arequipa Province and the Department of Arequipa. With a projected population of 1,195,700 in 2025, it is the country's second most populous city after Lima. It is the official seat of the Constitutional Court of Peru and is known as the "Legal Capital of Peru". Arequipa joined the UNESCO Global Network of Learning Cities in 2020.

zh.s: 阿雷基帕是秘鲁南部的一座城市，也是阿雷基帕省和阿雷基帕大区的首府。预计到2025年，人口将达到1,195,700人，是秘鲁人口第二多的城市，仅次于利马。秘鲁宪法法院的官方所在地设在此处，该市也被称为“秘鲁的法律之都”。阿雷基帕于2020年加入联合国教科文组织全球学习型城市网络。

en.s: The Battle of Hansan Island (Korean: 한산도 대첩) and the following engagement at Angolpo took place on 15 August 1592. In two naval encounters, Korean Admiral Yi Sun-sin's fleet managed to destroy roughly 100 Japanese ships and halted Japanese naval operations along the southern coast.

zh.s: 闲山岛海战（韩语：한산도 대첩）及随后在安骨浦发生的交战于1592年8月15日展开。在两场海战中，李舜臣率领的朝鲜舰队摧毁了约100艘日本船只，并阻止日军继续在朝鲜南海岸展开海上行动。

en.s: The Battle of Curlew Pass was fought on 15 August 1599 during the campaign of the Earl of Essex in the Nine Years' War, between an English force under Sir Conyers Clifford and a rebel Irish force led by Hugh Roe O'Donnell. The English were ambushed and routed while marching through a pass in the Curlew Mountains, near the town of Boyle, in the west of Ireland.

zh.s: 库鲁山口战役于1599年8月15日爆发，属于九年战争期间埃塞克斯伯爵的军事行动。交战双方是康纳斯·克利福德爵士率领的英军和休·罗·奥唐奈率领的爱尔兰叛军。英军在爱尔兰西部博伊尔镇附近穿越库鲁山脉山口时遭伏击并被击溃。

en.s: The first siege of Corbie took place 7–15 August 1636 during the Thirty Years' War and the Franco-Spanish War (1635–59) where a Spanish army under the Cardinal-Infante Ferdinand and his lieutenant Prince of Carignano successfully capture the important French fortress of Corbie. The siege would only last a little over a week with the fortress eventually surrendering after eight days on 15 August.

zh.s: 科尔比第一次围城战于1636年8月7日至15日爆发，属于三十年战争和法西战争（1635—1659年）的一部分。红衣主教—亲王费迪南德及其副手卡里尼亚诺亲王率领西班牙军队，成功攻占法国重要堡垒科尔比。围城持续略多于一周，堡垒在8月15日被围八天后投降。

en.s: The Battle of Kilsyth was an engagement of the Wars of the Three Kingdoms which took place on 15 August 1645 at Kilsyth. Despite a numerical disadvantage, the battle was another victory for the Royalist general Montrose over the Covenanters, and marked the end of William Baillie's pursuit of the Royalist forces.

zh.s: 基尔赛斯战役于1645年8月15日在苏格兰基尔赛斯爆发，是三王国战争中的一场战斗。尽管人数处于劣势，蒙特罗斯领导的保王军仍再次击败圣约派，并结束了威廉·贝利对保王军的追击。

en.s: The Cromwellian conquest of Ireland, 1649 to 1653, refers to the defeat of the Irish Catholic Confederation and their allies, by forces of the Commonwealth of England, led by Oliver Cromwell. It concluded the 1641 to 1653 Irish Confederate Wars and 1639 to 1653 Wars of the Three Kingdoms, which modern estimates generally agree led to an overall decline in the pre-1641 Irish population of over 15%, due to war, famine and disease.

zh.s: 克伦威尔征服爱尔兰（1649—1653年）指英格兰共和国军队在奥利弗·克伦威尔率领下，击败爱尔兰天主教联盟及其盟友。这场战争结束了1641年至1653年的爱尔兰联盟战争，以及1639年至1653年的三王国战争。现代估计普遍认为，战乱、饥荒和疾病导致爱尔兰人口较1641年前减少超过15%。

en.s: The siege of Christianstad (Danish: Belejringen af Christianstad, Swedish: Belägringen av Kristianstad), also known as the Capture of Christianstad (Danish: Overtagelsen af Christianstad, Swedish: övertagandet av Kristianstad), was a siege conducted by Christian V of Denmark on the Swedish-held city of Christianstad (Kristianstad) from 10 to 15 August 1676 during the Scanian War. The besieged Swedes would eventually surrender, and Christianstad would be occupied until 1678.

zh.s: 斯堪尼战争期间，丹麦国王克里斯蒂安五世于1676年8月10日至15日围攻瑞典控制的克里斯蒂安斯塔德（又作克里斯蒂安斯塔德）。被围的瑞典军最终投降，这座城市随后由丹麦占领至1678年。

en.s: During the Nine Years' War, the French Royal Army carried out a bombardment of Brussels from August 13–15, 1695. Led by King Louis XIV and the Duke of Villeroi, French forces bombarded the city in an attempt to divert Grand Alliance troops from reinforcing the concurrent siege of Namur. The bombardment ultimately proved to be the most destructive event in the history of Brussels, destroying a third of the buildings in the city, including the Grand-Place/Grote Markt (Brussels' main square).
en.n: French forces end the bombardment of Brussels.

zh.s: 九年战争期间，法王路易十四和维勒鲁瓦公爵率领的法国皇家军队于1695年8月13日至15日炮击布鲁塞尔，意在调走大同盟军队，阻止其增援正在进行的那慕尔围城战。这次炮击成为布鲁塞尔历史上破坏最严重的事件，摧毁了城内三分之一的建筑，包括大广场／格罗特市场（布鲁塞尔主广场）。
zh.n: 法军结束对布鲁塞尔的炮击。

en.s: The Battle of Luzzara was a battle of the War of the Spanish Succession, fought on 15 August 1702 near Luzzara, Italy between forces of France under Louis Joseph, duc de Vendôme, and forces of Austria under Prince Eugene of Savoy.

zh.s: 卢扎拉战役是西班牙王位继承战争中的一场战斗，于1702年8月15日在意大利卢扎拉附近爆发。交战双方分别是路易-约瑟夫·德·旺多姆公爵率领的法国军队，以及萨伏依的欧根亲王率领的奥地利军队。

en.s: The Battle of Liegnitz on 15 August 1760 saw Frederick the Great's Prussian Army defeat the Austrian army under Ernst von Laudon. The armies collided around the town of Liegnitz (now Legnica, Poland) in Lower Silesia. Laudon's Austrian cavalry attacked the Prussian position in the early morning but were beaten back by General Zieten's Hussars. An artillery duel emerged which was eventually won for the Prussians when a grenade hit an Austrian powder wagon. The Austrian infantry then proceeded to attack the Prussian line, but was met with concentrated artillery fire. A Prussian infantry counter-attack led by the Regiment Anhalt-Bernburg on the left forced the Austrians into retreat.

zh.s: 1760年8月15日，腓特烈大帝率领的普鲁士军队在利格尼茨战役中击败恩斯特·冯·劳东指挥的奥地利军队。双方在下西里西亚利格尼茨镇（今波兰莱格尼察）附近交战。清晨，劳东的奥地利骑兵进攻普军阵地，但被齐滕将军的骠骑兵击退。随后双方展开炮战；一枚榴弹击中奥军火药车后，普军占据上风。奥军步兵接着进攻普军防线，遭到集中炮火打击。由安哈尔特-伯恩堡团率领的普军步兵从左翼反攻，迫使奥军撤退。

en.s: The Action of 15 August 1799 was a naval engagement between the Portuguese and the Algerians. The Portuguese brigantine was sailing alongside merchant ships until intercepted by an Algerian ship. The brigantine and a merchant ship were captured by the Algerians.

zh.s: 1799年8月15日，葡萄牙与阿尔及利亚之间发生海战。一艘葡萄牙双桅横帆船与商船同行时遭阿尔及利亚船只拦截。阿尔及利亚人俘获了这艘双桅横帆船和一艘商船。

en.s: Battle of Schwyz im Muttenthal occurred on 14–15 August 1799 between French forces commanded by General of Division André Masséna and Major General von Franz Jellachich's brigade. The French lost 500 killed, wounded or missing, and the Austrians lost 2,400 men and six guns.

en.s: The Battle of Mišar (Serbian: Бој на Мишару, romanized: Boj na Mišaru) was fought between Serbian revolutionaries and an Ottoman army, it took place from 13 to 15 August 1806 during the First Serbian Uprising. After repulsing an Ottoman force at Ivankovac, the year before, the Serbian insurgents under Karađorđe took strong position, entrenched in sconces on the field of Mišar Hill, near Šabac west of Belgrade.

zh.s: 米沙尔战役于1806年8月13日至15日爆发，交战双方为塞尔维亚起义军和奥斯曼军队，属于第一次塞尔维亚起义。前一年，塞尔维亚军队在伊万科瓦茨击退奥斯曼军队后，卡拉乔尔杰率领的起义军在米沙尔山战场构筑防御工事并占据有利阵地。战场靠近贝尔格莱德以西的沙巴茨。

en.s: The Battle of Fort Dearborn was an engagement between United States troops and Potawatomi Native Americans that occurred on August 15, 1812, near Fort Dearborn in what is now Chicago, Illinois, but was then part of the Illinois Territory. The battle, which occurred during the War of 1812, followed the evacuation of the fort as ordered by William Hull, commander of the United States Army of the Northwest. The battle lasted about 15 minutes and resulted in a complete victory for the Native Americans. Fort Dearborn was burned down and those soldiers and settlers who survived were taken captive.

zh.s: 迪尔伯恩堡战役于1812年8月15日在美国军队与波塔瓦托米原住民之间爆发，地点在迪尔伯恩堡附近，也就是今天的伊利诺伊州芝加哥，当时该地属于伊利诺伊领地。战斗发生在1812年战争期间，此前美国西北部陆军司令威廉·赫尔下令撤出堡垒。战斗约持续15分钟，波塔瓦托米人取得压倒性胜利。迪尔伯恩堡被烧毁，幸存的士兵和定居者被俘。

en.t: War of 1812: British forces launch a costly and unsuccessful night attack against American defenders during the siege of Fort Erie
en.s: The War of 1812 was a conflict initiated by the United States against the United Kingdom and its allies fought mainly in North America and at sea during the wider Napoleonic Wars. The United States declared war on Britain on 18 June 1812. Although peace terms were agreed upon in the December 1814 Treaty of Ghent, the war did not officially end until the peace treaty was ratified by the United States Senate on 17 February 1815.

zh.t: 1812年战争：围攻伊利堡期间，英军夜袭美国守军，损失惨重且未能得手
zh.s: 1812年战争是美国对英国及其盟友发动的一场冲突，主要在北美和海上进行，同时处于更广泛的拿破仑战争背景下。美国于1812年6月18日对英国宣战。双方在1814年12月《根特条约》中达成和平条件，但直到1815年2月17日美国参议院批准和约，战争才正式结束。

en.t: Tivoli Gardens, one of the oldest still intact amusement parks in the world, opens in Copenhagen, Denmark
en.s: Tivoli Gardens, also known simply as Tivoli (Danish pronunciation: [ˈtsʰiwoli]), is an amusement park and pleasure garden in Copenhagen, Denmark. The park opened on 15 August 1843 and is the second-oldest operating amusement park in the world, after Dyrehavsbakken in nearby Klampenborg, also in Denmark. With 4.25 million visitors in 2024, Tivoli is the most visited amusement park in Scandinavia and second-most popular seasonal amusement park in the world after Europa-Park.

zh.t: 蒂沃利公园在丹麦哥本哈根开放
zh.s: 蒂沃利公园又称蒂沃利，是丹麦哥本哈根的一座游乐园和休闲花园，于1843年8月15日开放。它是全球仍在运营的游乐园中历史第二悠久的，仅次于附近克兰彭堡的迪尔海夫斯巴肯。2024年公园接待游客425万人次，是斯堪的纳维亚游客最多的游乐园，也是仅次于欧洲公园的全球第二受欢迎季节性游乐园。

en.s: The Bombardment of Kagoshima, also known as the Anglo-Satsuma War (薩英戦争, Satsu-Ei Sensō), was a military engagement fought between Britain and the Satsuma Domain in Kagoshima from 15 to 17 August 1863. The British were attempting to extract compensation and legal justice from daimyo Shimazu Tadayoshi for the 1862 Namamugi incident. The engagement began when a Royal Navy fleet commanded by Sir Augustus Kuper was fired on from Satsuma coastal batteries near Kagoshima.

zh.s: 鹿儿岛炮击事件又称英萨战争，发生于1863年8月15日至17日，是英国与萨摩藩在鹿儿岛进行的一场军事交战。英国试图向大名岛津忠义索取赔偿并讨回公道，起因是1862年的生麦事件。战斗开始时，奥古斯都·库珀爵士指挥的英国皇家海军舰队在鹿儿岛附近遭到萨摩藩海岸炮台射击。

en.s: The passage of Curupayty was an allied naval operation carried out on 15 August 1867, in the context of the Paraguayan War, which aimed to force the passage of Brazilian battleships against the defensive fortifications installed in the Curupayty fort on the banks of the Paraguay river. There was a second crossing on 13 February 1868 with a fleet of armored monitors destined to join the fleet that had crossed first to form the squadron responsible for forcing the Passage of Humaitá.

zh.t: 库鲁帕伊蒂突破行动（1867年）
zh.s: 1867年8月15日，在巴拉圭战争期间，盟军海军试图突破巴拉圭河岸库鲁帕伊蒂堡的防御工事，让巴西战舰通过。1868年2月13日，铁甲浅水炮舰组成的舰队再次通过，准备与先前通过的舰队会合，组成负责突破胡迈塔防线的舰队。

en.s: The Battle of Phu Hoai (15 August 1883) was an indecisive engagement between the Tonkin Expeditionary Corps and Liu Yongfu's Black Flag Army during the early months of the Tonkin campaign (1883–1886). The battle took place during the period of increasing tension between France and China that eventually culminated in the Sino-French War (August 1884–April 1885).

zh.s: 富怀战役于1883年8月15日爆发，是东京远征军与刘永福的黑旗军之间的一场未分胜负的交战，发生在东京战役（1883—1886年）初期。战斗发生在法中关系日趋紧张的时期，最终局势于1884年8月至1885年4月演变为中法战争。

en.t: Fratton Park football ground in Portsmouth, England is officially first opened
en.s: Fratton Park is a football ground in Portsmouth, Hampshire, and is the home of Portsmouth Football Club. Constructed in 1899, it has been the only home ground in Portsmouth F.C.'s history. The football ground's location on Portsea Island makes it the only professional English football ground not located on the mainland of Great Britain. The first match at Fratton Park took place in September 1899.

zh.t: 英格兰朴茨茅斯的弗拉顿公园足球场正式首次开放
zh.s: 弗拉顿公园是位于汉普郡朴茨茅斯的一座足球场，也是朴茨茅斯足球俱乐部的主场。球场建于1899年，一直是朴茨茅斯俱乐部历史上唯一的主场。由于球场位于波特西岛，它是英格兰唯一一座不在大不列颠岛本土上的职业足球场。弗拉顿公园的首场比赛于1899年9月举行。

en.s: The Battle of Peking (Chinese: 北京之戰), or historically the Relief of Peking (Chinese: 北京解圍戰), was the battle fought on 14–15 August 1900 in Beijing, in which the Eight-Nation Alliance relieved the siege of the Peking Legation Quarter during the Boxer Rebellion. From 20 June 1900, Boxers and Imperial Chinese Army troops had besieged foreign diplomats, citizens and soldiers within the legations of Austria-Hungary, Belgium, Britain, France, Italy, The German Empire, Japan, Netherlands, The Russian Empire, Spain and the United States.

zh.s: 北京之战又称“北京解围战”，于1900年8月14日至15日爆发。义和团运动期间，八国联军解除了对北京使馆区的围困。自1900年6月20日起，义和团和清军围困了使馆区内来自奥匈帝国、比利时、英国、法国、意大利、德意志帝国、日本、荷兰、俄罗斯帝国、西班牙和美国的外交官、平民和士兵。

en.s: The Capture of Üskup marked a significant event during the Albanian revolt of 1912. Led by Idriz Seferi, Albanian rebels successfully seized Üskup from the Ottoman Authorities, which served as the capital of the Kosovo Vilayet at the time. This capture prompted the Young Turk government in Constantinople to accept the Albanian demands, chief among them being the establishment of an Autonomous Albanian vilayet.

en.s: The Battle of Cer was a military campaign fought between Austria-Hungary and Serbia in August 1914, starting three weeks into the Serbian Campaign of 1914, the initial military action of the First World War. It took place around Cer Mountain and several surrounding villages, as well as the town of Šabac.
en.n: World War I: Beginning of the Battle of Cer, the first Allied victory of World War I.

zh.s: 塞尔战役于1914年8月在奥匈帝国与塞尔维亚之间爆发，是第一次世界大战初期塞尔维亚战役开始三周后的军事行动。战斗发生在塞尔山及附近多个村庄，以及沙巴茨镇周围。
zh.n: 第一次世界大战：塞尔战役开始，这是第一次世界大战中协约国的首次胜利。

en.s: Frank Lloyd Wright Sr. (June 8, 1867 – April 9, 1959) was an American architect, designer, writer, and educator. He designed more than 1,000 structures over a creative period of 70 years. Wright played a key role in the architectural movements of the twentieth century, influencing architects worldwide through his works and mentoring hundreds of apprentices in his Taliesin Fellowship.

zh.t: 美国建筑师弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特的一名仆人在赖特位于威斯康星州的塔里埃森住宅纵火，并在那里杀害七人
zh.s: 弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特（1867年6月8日—1959年4月9日）是美国建筑师、设计师、作家和教育家。在长达70年的创作生涯中，他设计了1,000多座建筑。赖特在20世纪建筑运动中发挥了重要作用；他通过作品影响世界各地的建筑师，并在塔里埃森学徒团中指导了数百名学徒。

en.t: Since its inauguration on 15 August 1914, the canal has succeeded in shortening maritime communication in time and distance, invigorating maritime and economic transportation by providing a short and relatively inexpensive transit route between the two oceans, decisively influencing global trade patterns, boosting economic growth in developed and developing countries, as well as providing the basic impetus for economic expansion in many remote regions of the world
en.s: The Panama Canal (Spanish: Canal de Panamá) is an artificial 82-kilometer (51-mile) waterway in Panama that connects the Caribbean Sea with the Pacific Ocean. It cuts across the narrowest point of the Isthmus of Panama, and is a conduit for maritime trade between the Atlantic Ocean and the Pacific Ocean.

zh.t: 自1914年8月15日启用以来，运河缩短了海上交通所需的时间和距离；它提供了一条短而相对廉价的两洋通道，促进海运和经济运输，显著影响全球贸易格局，推动发达国家和发展中国家的经济增长，并为世界许多偏远地区的经济扩张提供了基本动力
zh.s: 巴拿马运河（西班牙语：Canal de Panamá）是一条位于巴拿马、长82公里（51英里）的人工水道，连接加勒比海和太平洋。它横穿巴拿马地峡最狭窄处，是大西洋与太平洋之间海上贸易的通道。

en.s: The landing at Suvla Bay was an amphibious landing made at Suvla on the Aegean coast of the Gallipoli peninsula in the Ottoman Empire as part of the August Offensive, the final British attempt to break the deadlock of the Battle of Gallipoli. en.s: Operation Romeo was a French World War II commando operation to disable German artillery atop the cliffs of Cap Nègre. The operation happened the evening before Operation Dragoon, the main invasion of Southern France. The force consisted of 800 French commandos of the 1er Commando Français de l'Afrique du Nord (First French Commando of North Africa), commanded by Lieutenant Colonel Georges-Régis Bouvet. The attacking flotilla included the command ship HMCS Prince David, HMCS Prince Henry, HMS Princess Beatrix, HMS Prins Albert and four U.S. Motor Torpedo Boats. At 0130 15 August, 95 commandos in landing craft from Prince David beached first, while the remainder of the force waited offshore. The commandos had to climb a 350 feet (107 m) tall cliff to reach their objective. Half an hour later, they sent word back that the enemy gun positions had been silenced. The main body of Romeo then came onto the beach. About 800 commandos moved quickly and were soon established across the main road between Toulon and the Riviera. 300 German soldiers were killed and 700 taken prisoner. The French commandos suffered 11 men killed and 50 wounded. The force held its position until relieved by VI Corps from the east on August 15, 1944.

zh.s: 罗密欧行动是第二次世界大战期间法国突击队的一次行动，目标是摧毁内格尔角悬崖上的德军炮兵阵地。行动在盟军入侵法国南部的“龙骑兵行动”前一晚展开。部队由800名法国突击队员组成，隶属北非第一法国突击队，由乔治-雷吉·布韦中校指挥。参战舰艇包括指挥舰“戴维王子”号、“亨利王子”号、“碧翠丝公主”号、“阿尔伯特王子”号，以及4艘美国鱼雷艇。8月15日凌晨1时30分，“戴维王子”号放下登陆艇，95名突击队员率先上岸，其余部队在近海等待。突击队员需要攀上约350英尺（107米）高的悬崖才能到达目标。半小时后，他们报告已压制敌方炮位，随后罗密欧行动主力登陆。约800名突击队员迅速行动，很快控制了土伦至蔚蓝海岸之间的主干道。德军有300人阵亡、700人被俘；法军有11人阵亡、50人受伤。部队守住阵地，直到1944年8月15日第六军从东面赶来接替。

en.s: The Battle of North Borneo took place during the Second World War between Allied and Japanese forces. Japanese opposition to the landings was sporadic initially, although as the campaign progressed a number of considerable clashes occurred and both sides suffered relatively significant casualties.

en.t: India becomes independent from British rule
en.s: India became an independent dominion under the arrangements established by the Indian Independence Act of 1947. The legislation ended British rule and provided for the partition of British India into the dominions of India and Pakistan. Jawaharlal Nehru became India's first prime minister as the country began building its new political institutions. Independence was celebrated after a long and varied struggle for self-government, but partition also brought displacement and widespread communal violence. The anniversary therefore marks both the creation of an independent state and a profound upheaval in the lives of millions across the subcontinent. India later became a republic in 1950.

zh.t: 印度摆脱英国统治，成为独立国家

en.s: South Korea, officially the Republic of Korea (ROK), is a country in East Asia. It constitutes the southern half of the Korean Peninsula and borders North Korea along the Korean Demilitarized Zone, with the Yellow Sea to the west and the Sea of Japan to the east. South Korea claims to be the sole legitimate government of the entire peninsula and adjacent islands.

zh.s: 韩国，正式名称为大韩民国（ROK），是东亚国家，位于朝鲜半岛南部。韩国北部与朝鲜以朝鲜非军事区为界，西临黄海，东临日本海。韩国主张自己是整个朝鲜半岛及邻近岛屿唯一合法的政府。

en.s: The 1950 Assam–Tibet earthquake, also known as the Assam earthquake, occurred on 15 August and had a moment magnitude of 8.7. The epicentre was located in the Mishmi Hills. It is one of the strongest earthquakes ever recorded on land. Occurring on a Tuesday at 7:39 PM Indian Standard Time, the earthquake was destructive in both Assam (India) and Tibet (China), and approximately 4,800 people were killed.

zh.s: 1950年8月15日，阿萨姆—西藏地震（又称阿萨姆地震）发生，矩震级为8.7级，震中位于米什米山。它是有记录以来陆地上震级最大的地震之一。地震发生在星期二印度标准时间19时39分，对印度阿萨姆邦和中国西藏造成严重破坏，约4800人死亡。

en.s: The Lynmouth Flood occurred on the night of 15–16 August 1952, principally affecting the village of Lynmouth, in North Devon. A storm with heavy rainfall, combined with already saturated soil and flood debris, led to the flooding of the village and a total loss of 34 lives.

On the afternoon of August 15, 1959, the Boeing 707 operating the flight crashed near the Calverton airport, killing all five crew members aboard.

en.s: The 1959 FA Charity Shield was the 37th FA Charity Shield, an English football match between the winners of the previous season's First Division and FA Cup titles. This year's match was contested by league champions Wolverhampton Wanderers and FA Cup winners Nottingham Forest. The match was held at the start of the season for the first time, and was staged at Wolves' stadium, Molineux.

en.t: The Republic of the Congo became fully independent from France on 15 August 1960
en.s: The Republic of the Congo, also known as the Congo Republic, Congo-Brazzaville, or simply the Congo, is a country located on the western coast of Central Africa to the west of the Congo River. It is bordered to the west by Gabon, to the northwest by Cameroon, to the northeast by the Central African Republic, to the southeast by the Democratic Republic of the Congo, to the south by the Angolan exclave of Cabinda, and to the southwest by the Atlantic Ocean.

zh.t: 刚果共和国于1960年8月15日脱离法国，正式独立
zh.s: 刚果共和国又称刚果（布）、刚果布拉柴维尔或简称刚果，位于中部非洲西部、刚果河以西的海岸地带。该国西邻加蓬，西北接喀麦隆，东北接中非共和国，东南与刚果民主共和国接壤，南面与安哥拉的卡宾达飞地相邻，西南临大西洋。

en.t: President Fulbert Youlou was overthrown in the Republic of Congo, after a three-day uprising in the capital
en.s: The Trois Glorieuses (lit. 'Three Glorious Days') was an uprising in Congo-Brazzaville which occurred from August 13 to 15, 1963. The uprising ended the rule of the first Congolese President, Fulbert Youlou, as the opposition trade union movement and Congolese Youth Union struck an alliance with the army.

zh.t: 刚果共和国总统富尔贝尔·尤卢在首都三日暴动后被推翻
zh.s: “三光荣日”（Trois Glorieuses，意为“三个光荣的日子”）是刚果（布）于1963年8月13日至15日发生的一场起义。反对派工会运动与刚果青年联盟联合军队发动起义，结束了该国首任总统富尔贝尔·尤卢的统治。

en.t: Execution of Henry John Burnett, the last man to be hanged in Scotland
en.s: Henry John Burnett (5 January 1942 – 15 August 1963) was the last man to be hanged in Scotland, and the first in Aberdeen since 1891. He was tried at the high court in Aberdeen from 23 to 25 July 1963 for the murder of merchant seaman Thomas Guyan. His execution, at HM Prison, Craiginches, Aberdeen, was performed by hangman Harry Allen.

zh.t: 亨利·约翰·伯内特被处以绞刑
zh.s: 亨利·约翰·伯内特（1942年1月5日—1963年8月15日）是苏格兰最后一名被处以绞刑的人，也是1891年以来阿伯丁首位被处决者。1963年7月23日至25日，他在阿伯丁高等法院因谋杀商船海员托马斯·盖恩受审。他在阿伯丁克雷金奇斯监狱被处决，行刑者为哈里·艾伦。

en.s: The 1964 FA Charity Shield was the 42nd FA Charity Shield, an annual football match played between the winners of the previous season's First Division and FA Cup competitions. The match was played on 15 August 1964 at Anfield, Liverpool and contested by Liverpool, who had won the 1963–64 First Division, and West Ham United, who had won the 1964 FA Cup Final.

zh.s: 1964年英格兰慈善盾是第42届英格兰慈善盾年度足球赛，由上赛季英格兰顶级联赛和足总杯的冠军对阵。比赛于1964年8月15日在利物浦的安菲尔德球场举行，参赛双方是赢得1963—64赛季顶级联赛冠军的利物浦，以及赢得1964年足总杯的西汉姆联。

en.s: The Beatles staged their second concert tour of the United States (with one date in Canada) in the late summer of 1965. At the peak of American Beatlemania, they played a mixture of outdoor stadiums and indoor arenas, with historic concerts at Shea Stadium in New York and the Hollywood Bowl. Typical of the era, the tour was a "package" presentation, with several artists on the bill.

zh.t: 披头士乐队1965年美国巡演
zh.s: 1965年夏末，披头士乐队举行了第二次美国巡回演唱会，其中有一场在加拿大。正值美国“披头士狂热”高峰期，他们在露天体育场和室内场馆演出，纽约谢伊体育场和好莱坞圆形剧场的演唱会尤其具有历史意义。和当时常见的形式一样，这次巡演采用“组合演出”模式，多位艺人同台演出。

en.s: The EMLL 36th Anniversary Show was a professional wrestling major show event produced by Empresa Mexicana de Lucha Libre (EMLL) that took place on August 15, 1969 in Arena México, Mexico City, Mexico. The event commemorated the 36th anniversary of EMLL, which would become the oldest professional wrestling promotion in the world. This was the first Anniversary show to take place in August.

zh.s: EMLL第36周年纪念赛是墨西哥摔角企业（EMLL）举办的一场大型职业摔角赛事，于1969年8月15日在墨西哥城的墨西哥竞技场举行，以纪念EMLL成立36周年。EMLL后来成为世界上历史最悠久的职业摔角推广机构。这是周年纪念赛首次在8月举行。

en.t: Yuk Young-soo, First Lady of South Korea, is killed during an apparent assassination attempt upon President Park Chung Hee
en.s: Yuk Young-soo (Korean: 육영수; 29 November 1925 – 15 August 1974) was the wife of the 3rd South Korean president Park Chung Hee and the mother of the 11th South Korean president Park Geun-hye. She was the first lady when Park was in office, from 1962 until she was killed in 1974 during an attempted assassination of her husband.

zh.t: 第一夫人陆英修在总统朴正熙遇刺事件中身亡
zh.s: 陆英修（韩语：육영수，1925年11月29日—1974年8月15日）是韩国第三任总统朴正熙的妻子，也是第11任总统朴槿惠的母亲。朴正熙自1962年执政期间，她一直担任第一夫人，直到1974年在针对丈夫的刺杀行动中遇害。

en.s: A military coup was launched in Bangladesh on 15 August 1975, by mid-ranking army officers in order to assassinate President Sheikh Mujibur Rahman. Sheikh Mujibur Rahman, also known as Bangabandhu (lit. 'Friend of Bengal') or Mujib, was the country's founding president, but post-independence his administration grew corrupt and reportedly 'increasingly authoritarian' until he formed a 'one-party state' led by the socialist Bangladesh Krishak Sramik Awami League.

en.t: SAETA Flight 011 crashes into the Chimborazo volcano in Ecuador, killing all 59 people on board; the wreckage is not discovered until 2002
en.s: Chimborazo (Spanish: [tʃimboˈɾaso] ) is a stratovolcano in Ecuador and the Cordillera Occidental range of the Andes. Its last known eruption is believed to have occurred around AD 550. Chimborazo is the highest mountain in Ecuador and the 39th-highest peak in the entire Andes.

zh.s: 钦博拉索火山（西班牙语读音：[tʃimboˈɾaso]）是厄瓜多尔的一座层状火山，属于安第斯山脉西科迪勒拉山系。已知该火山上次喷发可能发生于公元550年前后。钦博拉索是厄瓜多尔最高峰，也是整个安第斯山脉第39高峰。

en.s: The 1976 Campeón de Campeones was the 34th edition of the Campeón de Campeones, an annual football super cup match. It was played at the Estadio Azteca, Mexico City, on 15 August 1976. América won the match 2–0 to secure their second Campeón de Campeones title.

en.t: 1992 South Africa vs New Zealand rugby union match
en.s: In 1992, South Africa played a rugby union test match against New Zealand, which later became known as the Return Test. It was a rugby union test match between the South African national rugby union team (colloquially known as the Springboks) and New Zealand national rugby union team (colloquially known as the All Blacks) at Ellis Park Stadium in Johannesburg on 15 August 1992. It was named as the Return Test as it was South Africa's first test match since the International Rugby Board (IRB) had banned them due to apartheid.

en.s: The Omagh bombing (Irish: Buamáil an Ómaigh) was a car bombing that took place on 15 August 1998 in Omagh, County Tyrone, Northern Ireland. It was carried out by the Real Irish Republican Army, a Provisional Irish Republican Army splinter group who opposed the IRA's ceasefire and the Good Friday Agreement. The bombing ultimately killed 29 people and injured some 220 others, the highest death toll from a single incident during the Troubles. Telephoned warnings had been sent about 40 minutes beforehand, but were inaccurate and police had inadvertently moved people towards the bomb.

zh.s: 奥马爆炸案（爱尔兰语：Buamáil an Ómaigh）是一起汽车炸弹袭击，于1998年8月15日在北爱尔兰蒂龙郡奥马发生。袭击由“真正爱尔兰共和军”实施，该组织是反对爱尔兰共和军停火和《贝尔法斯特协议》的分裂派别。爆炸最终造成29人死亡、约220人受伤，是北爱尔兰冲突期间单起事件中死亡人数最多的一次。袭击前约40分钟曾有人打电话发出警告，但警告信息不准确，警方又无意中把人群引向炸弹。

en.s: SummerSlam (2004) was the seventeenth annual SummerSlam professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE). It was presented by Stacker 2's YJ Stinger and took place on August 15, 2004, at the Air Canada Centre in Toronto, Ontario and featured talent from the Raw and SmackDown! brands. The main match on the Raw brand was Chris Benoit versus Randy Orton for the World Heavyweight Championship, which Orton won by pinfall after performing an RKO. The predominant match on the SmackDown! brand was John "Bradshaw" Layfield (JBL) versus The Undertaker for the WWE Championship, which JBL won after Undertaker was disqualified.

en.s: On 15 August 2017, Jordan held local elections for three levels of government: mayoralties, municipal and local councils, and governorate councils. While the municipal and local councils have been elected consistently since 1925, the governorate council elections are the first of their kind in Jordan, with the councils established by a new 2014 decentralization law.

zh.s: 2017年8月15日，约旦举行地方选举，选出三个层级的地方政府人员：市长、市政和地方议会议员，以及省议会议员。自1925年以来，约旦一直选举市政和地方议会议员；这次则首次举行省议会选举，这类议会是依据2014年新的权力下放法设立的。

en.s: The 2017 Suruga Bank Championship (Japanese: スルガ銀行チャンピオンシップ2017; Spanish: Copa Suruga Bank 2017) was the tenth edition of the Suruga Bank Championship (also referred to as the J.League Cup / Copa Sudamericana Championship Final), the club football match co-organized by the Japan Football Association, the football governing body of Japan, CONMEBOL, the football governing body of South America, and J.League, the professional football league of Japan, between the champions of the previous season's J.League Cup and Copa Sudamericana. The match was contested between Japanese team Urawa Red Diamonds, the 2016 J.League Cup champions, and Brazilian team Chapecoense, the 2016 Copa Sudamericana champions. It was hosted by Urawa Red Diamonds at the Saitama Stadium 2002 in Saitama, Japan on 15 August 2017.

zh.s: 2017年骏河银行锦标赛（也称J联赛杯／南美解放者杯冠军赛）是该项赛事的第10届，由日本足球协会、南美洲足球联合会（CONMEBOL）和日本职业足球联盟（J联赛）共同组织。比赛由上赛季J联赛杯和南美杯冠军交锋，参赛双方是2016年J联赛杯冠军浦和红钻，以及2016年南美杯冠军沙佩科恩斯。赛事由浦和红钻主办，于2017年8月15日在日本埼玉市的埼玉2002体育场举行。

en.s: The 2018 UEFA Super Cup was the 43rd edition of the UEFA Super Cup, an annual football match organised by UEFA and contested by the reigning champions of the two main European club competitions, the UEFA Champions League and the UEFA Europa League. The match featured two Spanish sides, two-time defending champions Real Madrid, the winners of the 2017–18 UEFA Champions League, and Atlético Madrid, the winners of the 2017–18 UEFA Europa League, setting up a Madrid derby, making it another time 2 teams from the same country faced each other, and the first time 2 teams from the same city clashed. It was played at the Lilleküla Stadium in Tallinn, Estonia, on 15 August 2018, and was the first European club final held in Estonia.

zh.s: 2018年欧洲超级杯是第43届欧洲超级杯年度足球赛，由欧足联组织，参赛双方为欧洲冠军联赛和欧洲联赛的卫冕冠军。本届比赛由两支西班牙球队交锋：两届卫冕冠军、2017—18赛季欧冠冠军皇家马德里，对阵欧联冠军马德里竞技。这是欧战决赛中又一次由同一国家的两队交锋，也是首次由同一城市的两支球队相遇。比赛于2018年8月15日在爱沙尼亚塔林的利勒屈拉球场举行，是首次在爱沙尼亚举办的欧洲俱乐部决赛。

en.t: Russia begins production on the Sputnik V COVID-19 vaccine
en.s: Sputnik V (Russian: Спутник V, the brand name from the Russian Direct Investment Fund or RDIF) or Gam-COVID-Vac (Russian: Гам-КОВИД-Вак, the name under which it is legally registered and produced) is an adenovirus viral vector vaccine for COVID-19 developed by the Gamaleya Research Institute of Epidemiology and Microbiology in Russia. It is the world's first registered combination vector vaccine for the prevention of COVID-19, having been registered on 11 August 2020 by the Russian Ministry of Health.

zh.t: 俄罗斯开始生产“卫星五号”新冠疫苗
zh.s: “卫星五号”（俄语：Спутник V；俄罗斯直接投资基金（RDIF）使用的品牌名），也称Gam-COVID-Vac（俄语：Гам-КОВИД-Вак；法律注册和生产时使用的名称），是俄罗斯加马列亚流行病学与微生物学研究所研发的一种用于预防新冠肺炎的腺病毒载体疫苗。它是世界上首款获注册的新冠肺炎联合载体疫苗，于2020年8月11日由俄罗斯卫生部注册。

en.s: On 15 August 2021, Afghanistan's capital city of Kabul was captured by the Taliban after a major insurgent offensive that began in May 2021. It was the final action of the War in Afghanistan, and marked a total victory for the Taliban. This led to the overthrowing of the Islamic Republic of Afghanistan under President Ashraf Ghani and the reinstatement of the Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan under the control of the Taliban.
